lines.en: label amispecial50mainp2:
scene artpicture
Let me tell you a story.
lines.zh: 我给你讲个故事吧。

lines.en: A long time ago, before either one of us existed, there was a seed.
lines.zh: 很久以前，在我们两个都还不存在的时候，有一颗种子。

lines.en: There was also a light.
lines.zh: 还有一道光。

lines.en: The light nourished the seed. Then it grew into some other thing and another thing showed up and then more stuff happened and here we are.
lines.zh: 那道光滋养了那颗种子。后来它长成了别的什么东西，又冒出另一件东西，然后又发生了更多的事——于是我们到了今天。

lines.en: It’s all very difficult to follow.
lines.zh: 这一切很难理清。

lines.en: But the important thing to take away from all of it is that there was a very specific order events needed to occur in for us to make it to where we are today.
lines.zh: 但其中最要紧的一点是：必须按一个非常特定的顺序发生，我们才能走到今天这里。

lines.en: But what if that light had never appeared?
lines.zh: 可要是那道光从未出现呢？

lines.en: What if that seed was never nourished?
lines.zh: 要是那颗种子从未被滋养呢？

lines.en: We’re fragile things, you and me.
lines.zh: 我们是脆弱的东西，你和我。

lines.en: I may not look the part, but I am no more or less mortal than you.
lines.zh: 我看上去也许不像，但我跟你一样会死，一分不多，一分不少。

lines.en: If you pinch me, I will scream. And if you cut my belly open, the same stream of colors would pour from {i}my{/i} body as yours if I were to return the favor and open you the same way.
lines.zh: 你掐我，我就会叫。你要是剖开我的肚子，从{i}我{/i}身体里流出来的颜色，也会和你身体里流出来的一样——如果我礼尚往来，用同样的方式剖开你的话。

lines.en: All it takes for us to disappear is one little mistake.
lines.zh: 我们消失，只需要一个小小的差错。

lines.en: And it’s scary enough going outside knowing that this mistake does not even have to rest in {i}your{/i} hands...and that your life could be cut short by someone {i}else{/i} tripping over their own eight feet.
lines.zh: 光是出门就已经够吓人的了，因为你知道那个差错甚至不必握在{i}你{/i}自己手里……你的人生可能被{i}另一个{/i}被自己八只脚绊了一跤的家伙给切断。

lines.en: How terribly unfair is that?
lines.zh: 这得多不讲理啊？

lines.en: Why would anyone ever go outside in the first place knowing everything they think and feel could come crashing down at any moment?
lines.zh: 明知自己所有的思绪和感情随时可能轰然崩塌，人为什么还要踏出门去？

lines.en: It all gets more complicated when you realize that simply isolating yourself won’t help either.
lines.zh: 而且当你意识到，光把自己关起来也没用的时候，一切就更复杂了。

lines.en: Time moves in both ways.
lines.zh: 时间是双向流动的。

lines.en: There are things happening in every direction, and every single one of them could impact where you’ll be tomorrow and who you’ll see the next time you open your eyes.
lines.zh: 每个方向都有事在发生，而其中任何一件都可能影响你明天会在哪儿，以及你下次睁开眼会看见谁。

lines.en: Which is why we should cherish the dark.
lines.zh: 所以我们才该珍惜黑暗。

lines.en: For if there is no light, and there is no seed — there would have never been a you or me.
lines.zh: 因为如果没有光，也没有种子——那就根本不会有你或我。

lines.en: Our fragile timeline would snap like an old bridge and everyone we know, currently trapped between the wooden stakes holding it up labeled {i}past{/i} and {i}future{/i}, would plummet to their deaths.
lines.zh: 我们脆弱的时间线会像一座旧桥一样断裂，所有我们认识的人——此刻正卡在支撑它的木桩之间，一根叫「{i}过去{/i}」，一根叫「{i}未来{/i}」——都会坠落而死。

lines.en: But that’s just a metaphor.
lines.zh: 不过那只是个比喻。

lines.en: It would be more like never existing in the first place.
lines.zh: 更像是打从一开始就没存在过。

lines.en: We’d feel no pain as we’d have never developed the ability to feel it.
lines.zh: 我们不会感到痛苦，因为我们从未发展出感受它的能力。

lines.en: There would be no lingering regret of a future unexplored because we’d never be ordained to explore it at all.
lines.zh: 也不会有什么「未来没能去探索」的遗憾，因为我们根本没被注定要去探索它。

lines.en: We’d just be energy, or a lack thereof — waiting for whatever we’re supposed to cite as the creator to just press the start button so we can begin our long and painful journey.
lines.zh: 我们只会是能量——或者能量的缺失——等着那个我们该称之为「造物主」的东西按下启动键，好让我们开始这段漫长而痛苦的旅程。

lines.en: In a sense...
lines.zh: 从某种意义上说……

lines.en: That makes you a bit of a god too, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 这也让你有那么点像神了，不是吗？

lines.en: What if we’re {i}all{/i} gods? Packed to the gills with divine blood and celestial plasma- all simultaneously pressing “Start” but spawning in different locations at different stages in life.
lines.zh: 会不会我们{i}全都{/i}是神？满得溢出来的圣血与天界血浆——同时按下「开始」，却在人生的不同阶段、不同地点降生。

lines.en: These are questions I can only pose as the dark was killed by what came after.
lines.zh: 这些是我只能提出来的问题——因为黑暗被它之后到来的东西杀死了。

lines.en: But when I go to sleep at night, I dream of a world where it wasn’t.
lines.zh: 可我夜里入睡时，会梦见一个黑暗没被杀死的世界。

lines.en: And those dreams are so peaceful-
lines.zh: 而那些梦是那样安详——

lines.en: Because it’s more like they’re not even happening.
lines.zh: 因为更像是它们根本就没有在发生。

lines.en: scene black
Sometimes, it feels like there’s a little too much truth floating around.
lines.zh: 有时候会觉得，漂浮在四周的真相有点太多了。

lines.en: So much, in fact, that if you were to spend the entirety of your life doing nothing but collecting information, you’d {i}still{/i} know nothing at all when your time here has come and gone.
lines.zh: 多到就算你用一辈子什么都不干、只收集信息，等你这一遭走完，{i}依旧{/i}什么也不懂。

lines.en: It’s no different for those of us who can never expire.
lines.zh: 对我们这些永远不会消亡的存在来说，也没什么不同。

lines.en: I, too, often feel that it’s all so overwhelming.
lines.zh: 我也常常觉得这一切太过压人。

lines.en: Yet I remain here amidst the Nothing as it is my job to think.
lines.zh: 可我依旧留在这片「无」之中，因为思考是我的职责。

lines.en: It goes deeper than you know.
lines.zh: 它比你以为的要深得多。

lines.en: For every question answered, there will be ten more asked.
lines.zh: 每回答一个问题，就会有十个新的被提出来。

lines.en: With that in mind, would it not be better to wish that we were all just gone?
lines.zh: 想到这一点，难道不反而该希望我们全都干脆消失掉吗？

lines.en: Only in the light will you be given a mission.
lines.zh: 只有在光里，你才会被赋予使命。

lines.en: And only in the dark will it be fulfilled.
lines.zh: 只有在黑暗里，它才会被完成。

lines.en: It’s such a shame that these two cannot co-exist.
lines.zh: 这两者无法共存，实在可惜。

lines.en: Tell me-
lines.zh: 告诉我——

lines.en: And I only ask this because I’ve been wondering for quite some time-
lines.zh: 我问这个，只是因为我想了挺久了——

: I should answer the door.
lines.zh: : 我该去开门。

lines.en: scene black
scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb1
: What the fuck are you smiling about?! I’m trying to have a serious conversation with you!
lines.zh: : 你他妈在笑什么？！我正在跟你谈正事！

lines.en: : I’m obviously smiling because it looks like you two are still my friends after all! Yay!
lines.zh: : 我笑当然是因为——看来你们俩果然还是我的朋友呀！耶！

lines.en: : But you might want to keep it {i}juuuuuuuuust{/i} a little bit quieter or you’ll wake Sensei up. And he needs his sleep or he’ll be grumpy all day.
lines.zh: : 不过你们最好把声音压低{i}——那么——{/i}一点点，不然会把 Sensei 吵醒的。他缺觉的话，一整天都会闹脾气。

lines.en: : I’m already awake, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我已经醒了，Ami。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb2

: Oh, good morning. I just made some coffee with our brand new 10-cup Chemex Vase that you can help yourself to. Sorry Maya’s such a loud-mouth and wound up waking you up. I tried to get her to be quiet.
lines.zh: : 噢，早上好。我刚用我们全新的十杯装 Chemex 壶煮了咖啡，你自己倒就行。抱歉 Maya 太吵，把你吵醒了。我试着让她小声点的。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb3
Ayane quickly retreats to my side as soon as I-
lines.zh: 我一动，Ayane 就立刻缩到了我身边——

lines.en: : Ayane, what do you think you’re-
lines.zh: : Ayane，你这是在——

lines.en: : Ami! Talk to me! {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s pissed off at you right now, not Ayane!
lines.zh: : Ami！跟我说话！现在生你气的是{i}我{/i}，不是 Ayane！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb4
: Sorry, did you say {i}you’re{/i} pissed off at me? Shouldn’t it be the other way around?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说{i}你在{/i}生我的气？难道不该反过来吗？

lines.en: : After you called us out in the middle of the night and ditched us? No. It probably shouldn’t. And I think it’s pretty fucking normal that we’re mad at you about that.
lines.zh: : 在你半夜把我们叫出去、然后又放我们鸽子之后？不。大概不该反过来。而且我觉得我们为这事生你的气，他妈再正常不过了。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb5
: {i}I{/i} ditched you?! Are you kidding?! You guys called {i}me{/i} and told me to meet you in the Old District! Even after I said I didn’t want to!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}放你们鸽子？！你开玩笑吧？！是你们打电话叫{i}我{/i}到老城区见面的！我明明说了我不想去！

lines.en: : We...what? No, that’s-
lines.zh: : 我们……什么？不，那是——

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how lost I was?! It’s a miracle Sensei was able to find me!
lines.zh: : 你知道我当时迷路迷成什么样吗？！Sensei 能找到我简直是个奇迹！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb6
: Bullshit! You’re the one who called me and told me to meet you at the shrine!
lines.zh: : 放屁！是你打电话叫我去神社见面的！

lines.en: : Why would I ever ask to meet you at the shrine? That’s stupid. If you’re going to come up with a lie, at least make it a believable one.
lines.zh: : 我干嘛要约你去神社？真蠢。你要编谎话，至少编个可信点的。

lines.en: : It’s more believable than me asking you to meet me in the Old District when you know I can’t even go there!
lines.zh: : 总比我说叫你去老城区可信吧——你明知道我根本去不了那儿！

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么去不了？

lines.en: : Why not what?
lines.zh: : 为什么……什么？

lines.en: : Why can’t you go there, Maya? I don’t think you’ve ever told me before.
lines.zh: : 你为什么去不了那儿，Maya？我记得你从没跟我说过。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb7
: I’m a good friend, so I never bothered prying. But if you’re going to use that as an excuse, you should at least tell me {i}why,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 我是个好朋友，所以从不追问。但既然你要拿这个当借口，那你至少得告诉我{i}为什么{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Because if you {i}don’t,{/i} it’s just going to sound like you’re making things up. And you’d {i}never{/i} do that, right?
lines.zh: : 因为你要是{i}不说{/i}，听起来就像是你在瞎编。而你{i}绝不会{/i}那样做，对吧？

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb8
: Oh! I know! How about we make it into a little game! I’ll confess one thing, and then you can confess another! It’ll be a good way for us to show each other we still value our friendship!
lines.zh: : 哦！我有办法了！我们来玩个小游戏吧！我说出一个秘密，然后你说出一个秘密！这是个不错的方式，能让我们证明彼此还在乎这段友情！

lines.en: : You start! Why can’t you go to the Old District?
lines.zh: : 你先来！你为什么去不了老城区？

lines.en: : What do you think you’re doing?
lines.zh: : 你这是在干什么？

lines.en: : Fine! {i}I’ll{/i} start!
lines.zh: : 好！那{i}我{/i}先来！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb9
: Sometimes, I try on your clothes while you’re not around and pretend to be you! And I’m happy to say that my Maya impression is actually getting really good!
lines.zh: : 有时候你不在，我会试穿你的衣服，假装我是你！而且我很高兴地宣布，我模仿 Maya 已经模仿得相当像了！

lines.en: : Your turn!
lines.zh: : 轮到你了！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb10
: Ayane, is everything-
lines.zh: : Ayane，你还好吗——

lines.en: : Mhm. All good. Just...a little headache. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 嗯。都好。只是……有点头疼。就这样。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s-
lines.zh: : 你确定真的只是——

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb11
: Mhm! Totally sure! Nothing to worry about here! Just...getting my daily dose of Sensei!
lines.zh: : 嗯！非常确定！这儿没什么好担心的！只是……在补我每日份的 Sensei！

lines.en: : Ayane, I’m really going to need you to-
lines.zh: : Ayane，我真的需要你——

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb12
: Ami! Come on!
lines.zh: : Ami！拜托！

lines.en: : Jeez, you’re really bad at this game.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你这游戏玩得真烂。

lines.en: : It’s not a game! And I have no idea what you’re trying to pull here by pretending {i}we’re{/i} the ones who ditched you, but it’s two against one here and you’re not fooling anybody!
lines.zh: : 这不是游戏！我不知道你装成是{i}我们{/i}放了你鸽子到底想干什么，但现在是二比一，你骗不了任何人！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb13
: It’s {i}always{/i} two against one lately! And I don’t know what it is that compelled you guys to stop treating me like a friend, but it’s not fair! I didn’t do anything to you! Ever!
lines.zh: : 最近{i}老是{/i}二比一！我不知道是什么让你们不再把我当朋友看，但这不公平！我从没对你们做过什么！从来没有！

lines.en: : If you wanna weed me out, that’s one thing! But if you think I’m gonna let you {i}bully{/i} me and pick on me by...leading me on and stuff, then you can get the heck out of my house!
lines.zh: : 你们想把我踢出去，那是另一回事！但要是你们以为我会任由你们……用吊着我这种方式{i}欺负{/i}我、找我麻烦，那你们就给我滚出我家！

lines.en: : {i}Bully{/i} you?...What the fuck are you talking about? We haven’t done anything like that.
lines.zh: : {i}欺负{/i}你？……你他妈在说什么？我们没做过那种事。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb14
: Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar! Liar!
lines.zh: : 骗子！骗子！骗子！骗子！骗子！骗子！骗子！骗子！

lines.en: : You guys are picking on me because you don’t like how close I am to Sensei and you’re trying to take him away! But I won’t let you! He’s mine and he sees everything I do! He’ll be on my side no matter what!
lines.zh: : 你们找我麻烦，是因为不喜欢我跟 Sensei 这么亲，还想把他抢走！但我不会让你们得逞！他是我的，我做的一切他都看在眼里！不管怎样他都会站在我这边！

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb15
: Right, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 对吧，Sensei？！

lines.en: : Nh!
: Ami, I get that you’re upset, but can you stop yelling? I’m pretty sure you’re scaring Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ami，我知道你在生气，但你能别吼了吗？我敢肯定你把 Ayane 吓到了。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb16

: {i}Scaring{/i} her? I don’t think that’s true. She’s probably just being manipulated by Maya into thinking I’m the bad guy when I’m not even {i}that{/i} mad at her. {i}Maya’s{/i} the one who called me last night after all.
lines.zh: : {i}吓到{/i}她？我不这么认为。她大概只是被 Maya 操纵，以为我是坏人——可我压根没{i}那么{/i}生她的气。毕竟昨晚打电话给我的是 {i}Maya{/i}。

lines.en: : So if Ayane wants to apologize for ditching me, I’ll forgive her right now since I’m such a good person!
lines.zh: : 所以如果 Ayane 愿意为放我鸽子道歉，我现在就原谅她，毕竟我这个人这么好！

lines.en: : Ayaneeeeeeeee?
lines.zh: : Ayaneeeeeeeee？

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb17
: H...Heeeeey Ami...Good morning...
lines.zh: : 嘿……嘿——Ami……早上好……

lines.en: : Wow, you really {i}do{/i} look scared. How come? Don’t you, like...know karate and stuff? Shouldn't {i}I{/i} be the one afraid of {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哇，你看起来{i}真的{/i}被吓到了。怎么啦？你不是……会空手道什么的吗？难道不该是{i}我{/i}怕{i}你{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’m not afraid! I just...you know me! Always wanting to be close to Sensei and...that’s what I’m doing now.
lines.zh: : 我才没有害怕！我只是……你懂我的！我一直都想跟 Sensei 亲近，然后……我现在就是在做这件事。

lines.en: : Is that {i}really{/i} all you're doing?
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}只是在做这件事？

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb18
: Leave Ayane out of this! I’m the one yelling at you, not her!
lines.zh: : 别把 Ayane 扯进来！现在吼你的是我，不是她！

lines.en: : Nobody should be yelling at me since I’m a good girl who never does anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 谁都不该吼我，因为我是个从不做错事的好女孩。

lines.en: : All I wanted was to be friends with you and live happily ever after, but now you’re trying to force me out. You can’t blame me for being a little upset about that, can you?
lines.zh: : 我想要的只是跟你们做朋友，然后幸福快乐地过下去，可现在你们却要把我挤出去。我为这事有点不高兴，你们总不能怪我吧？

lines.en: : For the last time, no one is trying to force you out!
lines.zh: : 我最后说一次，没有人要挤走你！

lines.en: : Then how come you guys are always hanging out with Sensei without me? He’s {i}my{/i} uncle, you know. It’s really weird if other teenagers are just spending their free time hanging out with him.
lines.zh: : 那你们为什么老是不带上我、跟 Sensei 一起玩？他是{i}我{/i}叔叔啊。别的高中生光是拿空闲时间跟他混在一起，就已经很奇怪了。

lines.en: : Ami, it’s up to me how I spend my time. Don’t take my decisions out on them.
lines.zh: : Ami，我的时间怎么花是我自己决定的。别把我的决定怪到她们头上。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb19
: So {i}you’re{/i} the one deciding to hang out with my friends without me? It’s not just them trying to steal you?
lines.zh: : 所以是{i}你{/i}决定背着我跟我朋友玩的？不只是她们想抢你？

lines.en: : If I say yes, will you leave them alone?
lines.zh: : 如果我说是，你会放过她们吗？

lines.en: : You say that like I’m tormenting them. They’re the ones who showed up here. I was just trying to be a good niece and make breakfast like I always do.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得好像我在折磨她们似的。是她们自己找上门来的。我只是想像往常一样当个好侄女，做顿早饭。

lines.en: : If I really wanted to torment them, I wouldn’t wait for them to find me, would I?
lines.zh: : 我要真想折磨她们，就不会等她们找上门了，对吧？

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : When have I ever gone out of my way to do {i}anything{/i} mean to Ayane or Maya? I just want them to love me as much as I love them.
lines.zh: : 我什么时候特意去{i}刻薄{/i}过 Ayane 或 Maya？我只是希望她们爱我，就像我爱她们那么多。

lines.en: : Then just...put all of this behind you for now.
lines.zh: : 那就……先把这些都放下吧。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb20
: You’re...gonna forgive them for leading me to the middle of nowhere that easily? Really?
lines.zh: : 你……就因为她们把我骗到那种鸟不拉屎的地方，这么轻易就原谅她们？真的？

lines.en: : We didn’t do-
lines.zh: : 我们没做——

lines.en: : Maya, let me handle this.
lines.zh: : Maya，让我来处理。

lines.en: : I don’t care who called who or...who {i}ditched{/i} who, but something like that is too small to kill a friendship over when you’ve all known each other for years.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎谁打了谁的电话，或者……谁{i}放了{/i}谁的鸽子，但你们认识这么多年了，这种事太小了，不值得为它断送一段友情。

lines.en: : So just put it behind you for now and...try to move on. And know that Maya and Ayane probably wouldn’t have shown up here if they {i}didn’t{/i} care about you. They came here {i}because{/i} they cared.
lines.zh: : 所以就先把它放下……试着往前走吧。你要明白，Maya 和 Ayane 要是{i}不在乎{/i}你，大概根本不会找来这儿。她们来，是{i}因为{/i}在乎。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb21
: Mm...I guess I didn’t really think of it like that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我大概没往那方面想过……

lines.en: : I just don’t want us growing apart and it really feels like they don’t want me as a part of the group sometimes...
lines.zh: : 我只是不想我们越走越远，而且有时候真的觉得她们不想要我待在这个圈子里……

lines.en: : I don’t mind apologizing and trying to move on, but...it’d be nice to hear them say they love me at least.
lines.zh: : 我不介意道歉、也不介意试着往前走，但是……至少能听她们说一句爱我，那该多好。

lines.en: : If they can do that...I can probably convince myself they don’t mean any harm.
lines.zh: : 如果她们肯那么做……我大概就能说服自己，她们没有恶意。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love you, Ami. And I hope this really {i}was{/i} just...some miraculous misunderstanding, but-
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}爱你的，Ami。我也希望这真的{i}只是{/i}……某种离谱的误会，但是——

lines.en: : I love you too, Maya...I’m sorry for getting mad.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，Maya……对不起，我发火了。

lines.en: : Don’t...
: Don’t...worry about it?...
lines.zh: : 别……放在心上？……

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb22
: Ayane? Do you-
lines.zh: : Ayane？你——

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb23
: ...Ayane?
lines.zh: : ……Ayane？

lines.en: : Mhm. I love you, Ami. A lot.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我爱你，Ami。很爱。

lines.en: : You don’t really look like-
lines.zh: : 你看起来不怎么像——

lines.en: : Just leave it for now, Ami. We all love you.
lines.zh: : 先别管这个了，Ami。我们都爱你。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb24
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : If you say so, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么说，Sensei。

lines.en: : But I’ll be keeping a close eye on everybody to make sure of that, okay?
lines.zh: : 但我会盯紧你们每一个人，确保这是真的，好不好？

lines.en: scene black
I actually manage to deescalate a situation for once and send Maya and Ayane on their way.
lines.zh: 我难得真的让一场冲突降温了，然后打发 Maya 和 Ayane 离开。

lines.en: And while I can’t help but feel like I should set up some kind of meeting with them to talk about this in the future, I realize that’s exactly what Ami has a problem with in the first place.
lines.zh: 虽然我忍不住觉得该找个机会跟她们坐下来谈这件事，但我意识到，那恰恰是 Ami 一开始就反感的东西。

lines.en: They might not be trying to “steal me” from her or anything like that, but I can only imagine how it must feel to watch everyone you love have fun without you.
lines.zh: 她们也许没有想「把我抢走」之类的，但我能想象，看着你爱的所有人撇开你玩得开心是什么滋味。

lines.en: Maybe this whole...Ami-reset situation could use a bit of a reevaluation on Maya’s end...Especially since she still hasn’t made it apparent what the big deal is when it comes to including her.
lines.zh: 也许这一整套……Ami 与重置的事，值得让 Maya 那边重新评估一下……尤其是她到现在还没说清楚，把 Ami 拉进来到底有什么大不了的。

lines.en: If we could actually involve Ami in some way...that might work wonders in getting her to go back to her normal, cheerful self.
lines.zh: 如果我们真的能让 Ami 以某种方式参与进来……说不定能创造奇迹，让她变回那个正常、开朗的自己。

lines.en: I love my niece. She’s one of the most amazing aspects of my life.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。她是我生命中最了不起的部分之一。

lines.en: But even I know when enough is enough.
lines.zh: 但就连我也知道，什么时候该适可而止。

lines.en: And she’s slowly turning into something that will be much harder to love.
lines.zh: 而她正在慢慢变成某种……会难爱得多的东西。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb25
: So...I guess I should be getting back to breakfast now, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么……我想我该回去做早饭了吧？

lines.en: : Ami...I think we need to have a little talk.
lines.zh: : Ami……我想我们得谈一谈。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: If it’s about me sleeping in your bed last night, I’m not going to apologize.
lines.zh: : 如果是关于我昨晚睡你床的事，我不会道歉。

lines.en: : I get that you don’t want to have sex with me for whatever stupid reason you came up with, but I didn’t lay a finger on you. Which is very impressive given just how much I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不想跟我做爱，不管你编出什么蠢理由，但我一根手指都没碰你。考虑到我当时有多想要，这已经相当不容易了。

lines.en: else:
: Don’t worry, I’m not pregnant. I already checked.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我没怀孕。我已经查过了。

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just...
lines.zh: : 不是那个。我只是……

lines.en: : I think you need to give me a little more space.
lines.zh: : 我想你得多给我一点空间。

lines.en: : Sure.
: I get that you’re dependent on me and everything, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道你依赖我之类的，但是——

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : No, listen. I get that you’ve essentially centered your entire life around me and that...me {i}not{/i} going along with that makes you feel insignificant-
lines.zh: : 不，你听我说。我知道你基本上把整个人生都围着我转，而我……{i}不{/i}顺着你，会让你觉得自己不重要——

lines.en: : Whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 随你。

lines.en: : But that’s not what I’m trying to do. I just need to be able to exist on my own now that I’m finally learning to...function as an adult and-
lines.zh: : 但这不是我的意思。我只是需要能靠自己存在下去，既然我终于学着……像一个成年人那样运作，而且——

lines.en: : You can have space.
lines.zh: : 你可以有空间。

lines.en: : Can you at least let me finish before you completely reject- Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 你至少让我的话讲完再彻底驳回……等等，什么？

lines.en: : I said you can have space. I get it.
lines.zh: : 我说你可以有空间。我懂了。

lines.en: : I’m too clingy. And I’ll try and be {i}less{/i} clingy for your sake since that’s what you want from me.
lines.zh: : 我太黏人了。为了你，我会试着{i}不那么{/i}黏人，因为那是你想要的。

lines.en: : Can I feel your forehead?
lines.zh: : 我能摸摸你的额头吗？

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb26
: Sensei, I’m not sick. I get it.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我没生病。我懂了。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. I know you love me enough to not make any...stupid mistakes that will hurt me or anything.
lines.zh: : 你想做什么就做什么。我知道你足够爱我，不会犯任何……会伤害到我的蠢错误之类的。

lines.en: : Plus, spending a little less time thinking about you will give me a chance to focus on other stuff for a little while.
lines.zh: : 再说，少花点时间想你，也能让我有机会把注意力放到别的事情上一阵子。

lines.en: : Ami, please let me feel your forehead.
lines.zh: : Ami，拜托让我摸摸你的额头。

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb27
: I know it’s probably not my place to ask for anything here since...this is all kind of the result of me just being a little too attached in the first place, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道我大概没立场在这儿要求什么，因为……这一切本来就怪我一开始太黏了，不过……

lines.en: : Would you mind if I asked for a {i}teensy{/i} little favor in exchange for more of this “space” that you want all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你介不介意我提一个{i}特别小{/i}的请求，来换你突然想要的这点「空间」？

lines.en: : How “teensy” are we talking here?
lines.zh: : 你说的「小」是多大？

lines.en: scene onlyamimattersandeveryoneelseisdumb28
: Really teensy.
lines.zh: : 真的特别小。

lines.en: : Then...what is it?
lines.zh: : 那……是什么？
